lane: زُلْقُومٌ _i. q._ حُلْقُومٌ [The _windpipe_]. (IDrd, S in art. زقم, L, and K.) === Also The خُرْطُوم [i. e. _nose,_ or _fore part thereof,_] of a dog: and of a beast of prey: and, accord. to IAar, [the _proboscis_] of an elephant. (TA.)
